text:
maria: Quick weekly sync — short run: three clusters with notable moves this week (Zeta/us-west-2, Vega/eu-central-1, Koi/ap-sg). Marketing feature rollouts + scheduled eval runs push next-7-day demand up ~double-digits. Can folks confirm risks and toss in any tactical asks?

sam: saw the spike overnight, Zeta had sustained 95% GPU util on the p4p pool for ~3h. Latency SLOs hit 350ms 10% tail. No error surge but queues backed up.

capacity-bot: forecast snapshot -> us-west-2 (Zeta): 2800 GPU-hrs/day (+14%), eu-central-1 (Vega): 1200 GPU-hrs/day (+8%), ap-sg (Koi): 650 GPU-hrs/day (+28%). Spot churn AP-SG: 12% expected term rate next 72h.

cheng: AP-SG spot churn is real — we observed 18% preemptions during the 02:00-06:00 window last night. Recommending moving 40% of low-latency traffic off spot for the next 3 days or pinning a small on-demand reserve.

lia: cost math -- if we convert 40% of Koi's 650 -> on-demand, rough run-rate delta is +$3.2k/day. Need confirm from infra before we approve any reserve.

maria: noted. can we get a cheaper mitigation first (autoscale tuning / batch shifting) before paying for on-demand?

kevin: quick tactical list: 1) bump Vega reserved by +2 nodes (8xA100 equiv) to de-risk model syncs, 2) shift non-prod batch evals from Zeta daytime to Zeta night and Koi off-peak, 3) lower cooldown on Koi horizontal-autoscaler from 300s -> 120s for faster reclaim.

sam: i'm +1 for the autoscale cooldown change, it reduced queueing during last test. I'll run a canary with 120s on Koi afternoon window.

lia: +1 on shifting batch. If sam's canary looks good, finance ok'd up to $2k/day buffer for 48h emergency on-demand while we smooth traffic.

maria: action items: - sam to canary cooldown change (owner: sam) - cheng to propose 3-day on-demand plan for Koi with exact instance counts (owner: cheng) - kevin to open infra change PR for Vega +2 reserved (owner: kevin) - lia to flag finance approval and cap (owner: lia).

kevin: small config snippet for the canary autoscaler change:```yaml
hpa:
  targetCPU: 70
  cooldownSeconds: 120
  scaleUpLimit: 50%```

cheng: noted, i'll draft the on-demand plan and include exact GPU-hour numbers + cost delta. Expect it in ~45m.

capacity-bot: queued forecast refresh for 30m — will post updated GPU-hrs after sam's canary results.

ops-bot: created ticket INFRA-5428 for Vega reserved bump -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-5428 :eyes:

maria: thanks all — let's reconvene in the 11:30 sync if any of the owners hit blockers. :thumbsup:
